topics.definition: Deep learning is a branch of machine learning that uses neural networks with multiple layers to learn complex patterns from data.
tips: Deep learning performs best with large datasets.

topics.definition: Artificial neural networks are computing models inspired by the human brain.
tips: More layers can learn more complex patterns.

topics.definition: A neuron receives inputs, applies weights and an activation function, then produces an output.
Neural networks contain input, hidden and output layers.
Activation functions introduce non-linearity into neural networks.
tips: ReLU is commonly used in deep networks.

topics.definition: Forward propagation passes input data through the network to generate predictions.
tips: Occurs during both training and inference.

topics.definition: Backpropagation updates model weights using prediction errors.
tips: Uses gradient descent to minimize loss.

topics.definition: Use quality data, suitable architectures and continuous evaluation.
